optional_value_chain.prompt_en: Create a clean landscape editorial infographic on the functional mushroom value chain. Connect cultivation and harvest, extraction and standardization, quality release and cross-border supply, formulation and manufacture, brand and consumer demand, distribution and retail. Use restrained botanical green, warm neutral background, precise simple icons and short legible labels. Add a subtle reverse feedback arrow for repeat demand and supply planning. Show trade-offs through small cues for consistency, sensory performance and replenishment. No amounts, statistics, numbered steps, logos, rankings, certificates or factory ownership claims. Avoid decorative mushroom clusters and dense explanatory text.
